fullPassage: Do you know one of the best remedies for coping with family tension? Two words: "I'm sorry." It's amazing how hard some people find them to say. They think that it implies weakness or defeat. Nothing of the kind. In fact, it is exactly the opposite. Another good way of relieving tension is a row! The sea is ever so much calmer after a storm. A row has another advantage. When tempers are raised, unspoken truths usually come out. They may hurt a bit, especially at the time. Yet, at the end, you know each other a bit better. Lastly, most of the tensions and quarrels between children are natural. Even when they seem to be constant, wise parents don't worry too much.

det.korean: imply(동사원형) → implies(3인칭 단수 현재형): 주어 it(단수) + 현재시제 → -s 추가.
det.analysis: 주어 it(3인칭 단수) + 현재시제 → implies. '~을 암시하다'의 현재 진술.
det.tip: 3인칭 단수 현재형: imply → implies (자음+y → -ies)

questions.passage: Do you know one of the best remedies for coping with family tension? Two words: "I'm sorry." It's amazing how hard some people find them to say. They think that it implies weakness or defeat. __________. In fact, it is exactly the opposite. Another good way of relieving tension is a row! The sea is ever so much calmer after a storm. A row has another advantage. When tempers are raised, unspoken truths usually come out. They may hurt a bit, especially at the time. Yet, at the end, you know each other a bit better. Lastly, most of the tensions and quarrels between children are natural. Even when they seem to be constant, wise parents don't worry too much.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: Nothing of the kind(전혀 그렇지 않다) — 앞의 '사과가 약함이나 패배를 암시한다'는 생각을 강하게 부정하는 표현.
det.analysis:
❌ ① That is absolutely true: 완전히 사실이다 — 앞 내용(사과=약함)을 긍정, 문맥 반대
❌ ② Everyone agrees with this: 모두 동의한다 — 앞 내용 긍정, 문맥 반대
✅ ③ Nothing of the kind: 전혀 그렇지 않다 — 원문 일치, 강한 부정
❌ ④ It depends on the situation: 상황에 따라 다르다 — 중립적, 단호한 반박 맥락과 불일치
det.tip: Nothing of the kind = 전혀 그런 것이 없다/전혀 그렇지 않다 (강한 부정 표현)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: wise parents don't worry too much(현명한 부모는 너무 걱정하지 않는다) — 아이들 사이 갈등은 자연스러우므로 현명한 부모는 과도하게 걱정하지 않는다는 결론.
det.analysis:
✅ ① wise parents don't worry too much: 원문 일치 — 자연스러운 다툼이므로 현명한 부모는 과도히 걱정 않음
❌ ② children learn to fight better: 싸움을 더 잘 배운다 — 문맥의 교훈과 방향 다름
❌ ③ parents should stop all arguments: 모든 다툼을 막아야 한다 — 본문 논지(다툼의 이점 인정)와 반대
❌ ④ children become more aggressive: 아이들이 더 공격적이 된다 — 본문의 긍정적 결론과 정반대
det.tip: most tensions and quarrels between children are natural → wise parents don't worry too much. 자연스러운 갈등 = 과도한 걱정 불필요.
